threshold_rule: Recalibrated 2026-10-05 against 456 studio leaves, 153 real-world non-studio leaves and 27 non-leaf photographs. The previous configuration weighted coherence 0.3 and detail 0.35 with feature at 0.0, and admitted 17 of 27 non-leaf photographs with a confident disease class, because coherence scores how peaked the disease posterior is and so is 1.0 for a confidently wrong prediction, while detail is 1.0 for nearly any photograph: an image with no vegetation scored 0.3*1 + 0.35*1 = 0.65, landing on the accept boundary. accept_threshold 0.9 is the highest value admitting none of the 27 non-leaf images. reject_threshold 0.05 sits below the weakest genuine leaf measured (0.0793). Updated 2026-10-06: added detail=0.3 to prefilter scoring so non-green leaves (cherry on white, blueberry, diseased apple) are no longer rejected before reaching the classifier. Non-leaf images passing the prefilter are still caught by the classifier (max non-leaf score 0.610 below the 0.62 accept threshold).
